capabilities.justification: Reads one .warrant specification and, for the v1 gate, one corpus.json; both paths are supplied on the command line, are size-capped before parsing and must be regular files (symbolic links are refused).
Writes the oracle's own enumeration digests to the single file named by --out or --emit-v2; it never writes beside the corpus and never overwrites an input.
Prints the gate verdict and the level census.

justification: Offline oracle: it parses and evaluates hostile .warrant text with no eval, exec or subprocess, opens no network connection and reads no environment variable.
